text: You see some mutants and children kneeling before a video screen.
source_text: You see some mutants and children kneeling before a video screen.

text: Pray with us for peace, child.
source_text: Pray with us for peace, child.

text: The Unity will prevail if we are strong. Meditate on the quality of strength.
source_text: The Unity will prevail if we are strong. Meditate on the quality of strength.

text: Our mission to save humanity requires faith. Pray with us.
source_text: Our mission to save humanity requires faith. Pray with us.

text: Unbeliever! Blasphemer! You will be punished!
source_text: Unbeliever! Blasphemer! You will be punished!

text: We must pray to be strong. The change is almost upon us.
source_text: We must pray to be strong. The change is almost upon us.

text: The Unity is our future, brother.
source_text: The Unity is our future, brother.

text: The Unity is our future, sister.
source_text: The Unity is our future, sister.

text: I believe in the Master. His will is our salvation.
source_text: I believe in the Master. His will is our salvation.

text: 你见到一些变种人和教徒跪在屏幕前。
source_text: 你见到一些变种人和教徒跪在屏幕前。

text: 和我们一起祷告吧，教徒。
source_text: 和我们一起祷告吧，教徒。

text: 如果我们强大，必能一统天下。让我们为了伟大的力量祈祷。
source_text: 如果我们强大，必能一统天下。让我们为了伟大的力量祈祷。

text: 我们拯救人类的使命需要信念，让我们一同祈祷吧。
source_text: 我们拯救人类的使命需要信念，让我们一同祈祷吧。

text: 异教徒！亵渎者！你一定会受到惩罚！
source_text: 异教徒！亵渎者！你一定会受到惩罚！

text: 我们必须祈祷力量，这几乎马上使我们改变了。
source_text: 我们必须祈祷力量，这几乎马上使我们改变了。

text: 兄弟，“同一”是我们的未来。
source_text: 兄弟，“同一”是我们的未来。

text: 姐妹，“同一”是我们的未来。
source_text: 姐妹，“同一”是我们的未来。

text: 我信任主教，他会拯救我们。
source_text: 我信任主教，他会拯救我们。
